children: Sky Quarry received a Nevada air permit and restarted operations at its Eagle Springs Refinery.
Received air permit from the Nevada Division of Environmental Protection enabling restart.
Restarted operations at Eagle Springs Refinery near Ely, Nevada—Nevada's only crude oil refinery.
Completed about $300,000 in repairs and upgrades identified in a 2025 TAR360 assessment.
Refinery nameplate capacity ~5,000 barrels per day; ~15,000 barrels of crude inventory on hand.
Company remains engaged with Nevada fuel resiliency efforts and pursuing PR Spring farm-in talks and power collaboration.

title: Sky Quarry restarts Nevada refinery after securing state air permit
